usageNotes: This is a dummy/stub endpoint that returns null and carries no payload; its sole purpose is to serve as a discoverable login-page hint for API clients and UI formatters that need to identify the authentication endpoint. No credentials or authentication are required (world-accessible). Prefer the POST /access/ticket endpoint when you actually need to create an authentication ticket.

examples.summary: Probe the ticket endpoint for login-page discovery

tips: Returns null — do not use this to validate credentials or check auth state; it will always succeed with an empty response regardless of whether the caller is authenticated.
The companion POST /access/ticket (create_access_ticket) is the real authentication endpoint that issues PVEAuthCookie + CSRFPreventionToken.
Useful in health-check or API-discovery scripts to confirm the PVE API is reachable without needing any credentials.
